Bug_Title: Assertions should not compare an object to itself
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the generated code by including an assertion that compares an object to itself within the showBug method. This comparison is noncompliant with the rule that assertions should not compare an object to itself.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUnit test case triggers the bug by calling the showBug method of the ExampleClass instance, which contains an assertion that compares an object to itself.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test results show that the test passed without any assertion failures, indicating that the assertion comparing an object to itself did not cause the test to fail.
